fields.title: 2026-W44 Investment team digest
fields.body:
## Projects seen this week
- **Spruce Robotics** (due diligence, Lin Xiao): follow-up meeting with a partner; agreed to start diligence.
- **Perch Coffee** (passed, He Jia): follow-up meeting, then declined.

## Key findings
- Spruce: remote configuration cuts delivery effort sharply; to be checked in customer visits.

## Stage changes
- Spruce Robotics: first meeting → due diligence
- Perch Coffee: first meeting → passed
fields.for-leadership: - Diligence on Spruce should look hard at the stability of the core algorithm team.
